We are sorry to hear that you have felt unhappy with your experience at the practice. Unfortunately, we are not able to go into personal or specific details in an open forum, but the best way to resolve any specific concerns is to contact us directly so that we can look into them properly.

For context, the practice operates a system called total triage. This means that every acute appointment request is reviewed by a senior clinician, usually the same day and often within two hours. The clinician decides the most appropriate way to address the issue, which might be by signposting elsewhere, giving advice, arranging a telephone consultation or booking a face-to-face appointment. Patients are directed to the most suitable member of the team, whether that is a GP, nurse or another specialist, so that the most complex cases are managed by the highest skilled staff while everyone can benefit from the skills of the most appropriate staff member.

In your case it sounds as though the clinician felt your needs could be best managed by a nurse, which is why that appointment would have been offered. This approach helps ensure that as many patients as possible are seen promptly and appropriately.

We do value feedback and would encourage you to get in touch with the practice directly if you would like us to review any specific concerns in more detail.

Kind regards

Chris 

(Practice Manager)

Thank you for your comments and I'm sorry that you feel that you have not received the service you felt you should have.
I don't know who your Mum is and obviously wouldn't discuss personal details in an open forum like this, but I can make some general comments.
We, like the rest of the NHS, have been extremely busy on phones and for appointments. Strep A added to Flu and Covid on top on expected winter pressures have meant slower responses than we would have liked and we can only apologise for that but we have finite resources.
The phone system should tell you exactly where you are in the queue and I have not seen any reports of anyone being cut off other than during a major national outage on 22/11/22.
I would appreciate any more details so I can check the logs if possible, although I am aware this was a few weeks ago.
We also suggest people try our website https://www.lissongroveandwoolwellmc.co.uk/ when needing to make admin requests and non-urgent appointments as it is much easier and avoids waiting in the phone queue. We do not as standard take appointment requests at the front desk for multiple reasons, but mainly as it disadvantages the most severely ill patients who are not well enough to come into the surgery to make an appointment. Again this is all driven by the most efficient allocation of limited resources whilst trying to ensure we correctly prioritise patients needs.
I am very sorry if the receptionist came across as rude, I am very surprised at that, as whilst patients often don’t like the message that they are given staff are usually extremely polite and professional when they deliver it. Again I would be very interested in more detail to track down who it was so I can check and deal with any issues.
Thank you for your feedback and I hope that there are no further issues.
Yours sincerely 
Chris 
Practice Manager
